text:
Alex: Heads-up — Finance flagged a steady ~22% bump in network egress costs tied to logs/traces/artifact transfers starting last Thursday. Seen by anyone else? :eyes:
BillingBot: [alert] anomaly_detected: network_egress_us-east-1 -> multi-region increased by 21.8% vs baseline (7d). Ticket: BILL-9821
Maria: Can you paste the billing query or cost breakdown? I can correlate with logging retention and replication tags.
Kevin: Pasted quick breakdown from cost explorer: us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 transfers = 1.2 TB/day x 4 days, estimated $2.4k extra. Also a smaller spike us-west-2 -> ap-southeast-1.
Kevin: Query I ran (rough):
```
select sum(bytes_transferred) from cross_region_transfers
where service = 'log-archive' and start >= '2026-03-05'
group by src_region,dst_region
```
Results show big chunk from prod-cluster-3 -> eu-west-1 for `log-archive` and `trace-export` buckets.
Jen: We rolled a change last week related to artifact replication defaults in infra. Could be related — I toggled a flag to reduce cross-region replay latency.
SRE-Oncall: Confirmed: I grepped sync logs and saw repeated `artifact-sync` jobs doing `aws s3 cp --recursive` across regions at 03:40 with ~1.1-1.4TB per run. Trace: `replication_job/replay_v2` starting 2026-03-04 03:40 UTC.
Alex: Were those supposed to be same-region? Our policy is keep logs within region unless retention policy requires replication.
Kevin: Looks like PR #4422 accidentally set replication to wildcard regions. Snippet from config:
```
replication:
  enabled: true
  regions: ["*"]  # oops
```
It should have been `regions: ["primary"]`.
Maria: Oof. That explains the steady ramp. Can we revert that setting and re-run the next nightly as a dry-run?
Jen: I'll disable the scheduled replay for tonight and open a rollback PR. Disabling now: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 job/replication-job` :thumbsup:
Priya: Finance here — pls add `cost-center` tags to the transfers if possible and raise a billing ticket so we can get a credit/adjustment while we fix this. Tagging is retroactive for some providers, but worth trying.
SRE-Oncall: We can also throttle the job and add an allowlist so only region-local copies run unless explicitly requested. I'll draft a patch to `replication-controller` to prefer local endpoints and add a `FORCE_CROSS_REGION` opt-in.
Alex: Concrete actions:
- Jen: disable job and open rollback PR (#?) — owner Jen
- Kevin/Maria: patch config to restrict regions + add unit tests — owner Kevin
- SRE-Oncall: patch controller to prefer local and add opt-in, run a dry-run to estimate egress reduction — owner SRE-Oncall
- Priya/Finance: open billing ticket (BILL-9821) and attempt retroactive tagging/credits — owner Priya
Kevin: Also recommending we add an alert on cross-region transfer volumes for `log-archive` > 200 GB/day so this is surfaced earlier.
Maria: I'll add a dashboard and a pager rule for large multi-region egress spikes.
Jen: Rollback PR up (draft) and job disabled. Will merge after Kevin's config patch lands.
Priya: Filing the billing request now, capturing the timeline and the suspected misconfig change.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Please update BILL-9821 and drop short notes here when blocked/unblocked. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: Quick estimate — restricting to same-region should drop the extra $2.4k/day to near-zero. Will post post-fix numbers after dry run.
SRE-Oncall: Found some stray `trace-export` tasks on a legacy worker pool that still had wildcard set. Patching that pool now.
Jen: Patch and rollback merged, job scheduled back as disabled.
Alex: Closing loop later today with finance. If we still see residual cross-region traffic after these changes, we'll open an infra postmortem.
Priya: Noted — I'll keep finance in the loop.
BillingBot: [update] BILL-9821 status: ticket created and assigned to Priya.
Alex: Thanks — great triage.
